name: verify-gis-spatial-data-443
description: Runs a real 7-parameter Helmert datum transformation with the published EPSG:1314 parameters, for lesson 443's proof block. Zero dependencies on purpose: the ~40 lines of arithmetic ARE the lesson, and proj4 as a root dependency of a static site that never calls it would be paid for by every npm ci. Never installed as a dependency of the main app.
